text:
nina: Quick announcement: preview rollout for B220-96 (bandwidth-optimized, 96GB) dedicated pools. Initial zones: SIN (ap-southeast-1) and IAD (us-east-5). Target workloads: large-context reranking, multimodal encoder-heavy workloads, and long-context chat. Pilot starts next Tuesday.

omar: What's the primary tradeoff vs MI300/MI400 families?

nina: TL;DR: B220-96 gives ~2.2x memory bandwidth vs our current 80GB line for sustained large-token generation; slightly higher cold-start latency but much better sustained throughput for >2k token windows. Not aiming to replace MI-series for raw FLOPs, but a sweet spot for long-context streaming.

ovk: Any specific network or storage requirements for private deployments?

vik: For Private (VPC) installs: require RDMA-enabled subnet + jumbo frames enabled. We'll add a checklist to the private-deploy docs. No additional KMS requirements beyond standard.

lina: Pilot quotas? Can internal teams request early access?

nina: Yes. Pilot pool counts: SIN=12 cards, IAD=16 cards. Internal pilot sign-up form in #eng. Priority: Platform/SRE, then product teams building long-context features, then partner pilots. Quotas are limited to 48-hour sessions for synthetic runs; please tear down when done.

ops-bot: Reservation created by nina: pool=b220-iad count=16 start=2055080000 end=2055684800 (preview-resv).

legal-bot: NOTE: Regulatory flag on SIN zone for data residency. Customers must opt-in in contract addendum for cross-region data flow during performance tracing.

sales-kate: Pricing guidance? We need a draft to show to prospective enterprise customers next week.

nina: Preview pricing will be trial credit. For quotes, use the internal band: 1.6x of our baseline dedicated rate for 96GB line pending final cost verification. I'll share a short pricelist in the sales drive.

omar: Any scheduling caveats (locality, preemptible, cache)?

nina: Non-preemptible for Dedicated. We do recommend node-affinity for multimodal jobs to avoid cross-rack bandwidth variance. KV cache behavior: large-context sessions should warm KV progressively; expect ~7-12s warmup for 2k token prefill on first request. We'll expose warmup metrics in console.

vik: Ops note: because of RDMA requirements, private installs must schedule a maintenance window with infra team. Expect a 4h window for the initial node-level tuning.

sales-kate: Could we add a single-slide comparison vs other dedicated SKUs? Very helpful for early engage.

nina: Will do. Action items: 1) Docs: add RDMA checklist + warmup guidance (assigned: vik). 2) Sales: get one-slide compare (assigned: kate). 3) Eng/SRE: sign pilot request form by Friday. 4) Legal: prepare short addendum for SIN data flows (legal-bot please co-ordinate). I'll post perf traces and the quickstart repo link once the pool is live. Thanks. :white_check_mark:
